ordering_criterion: difficulty of obtaining credible training improvement, not deployment maturity

common.target_model: Llama2-7B Base matching project llama2 reference
common.initialization: existing Base weights; no from-scratch 7B pretraining in this plan
common.optimizer: AdamW with BF16 compute and FP32 optimizer state

initial_loss.reduction: sum vocabulary for KL, then mean scored tokens for both CE and KL

common.server_executor_allocation_and_storage: to be agreed with server owner

tracks.name: four-input stochastic p-bit neural selector
tracks.inputs: four existing 16-token summary QK scores for each 64-token block, chronological order
tracks.mandatory_blocks: first and last two, deduplicated for short prefixes
tracks.mandatory_block_training: bypass network and exclude from BCE; q_eff=1 for count loss
tracks.teacher: full accurate Attention block probability mass
tracks.supervised_gradient: exact marginalization over 256 conditionally independent feedforward hidden states; BCE on output marginal probability
tracks.budget_loss: squared grouped-query mean of sum(q_eff) minus length-conditioned mean target; not a hard per-query quota
tracks.budget_minibatch: complete query/head groups with every valid block, not incomplete shuffled block rows
tracks.short_prefix_target: between mandatory and valid block counts; initial mean anchor min(8,valid_blocks)
tracks.initial_readout: accurate candidate PV to isolate selection, then actual Ising
tracks.capacity: record full distribution and overflow rate; existing 512-slot TLM is not automatically sufficient
tracks.hardware_input_weight_precision: freeze with hardware owner before deployment validation

tracks.name: W8 and stratified short-stream FFN
tracks.gradient: floating master weights, deployment W8 forward and explicit quantization/stream surrogate
tracks.export: merge adapters if used, requantize and reload W8; retain old weight SHA

tracks.name: finite Ising observation adaptation
tracks.initial_selection_control: existing fixed8 to isolate S; not the new selector architecture requirement
tracks.later_selection: track3 variable output with capacity revalidated
tracks.first_stage: fixed teacher hidden, scores and candidates; train V/O by reconstruction after O projection against detached same-candidate teacher output
tracks.forward: actual finite hard-onehot CTMC indices directly gather V and average
tracks.QK_gradient: biased smooth softmax proxy using detached V
tracks.trajectory_repeats: if used, average losses rather than pooling samples into a larger S
tracks.training_dispatch: new causal training wrapper; current eval-only multi-token SDPA fallback cannot establish adaptation
tracks.FFN: original BF16 initially; track1 combination only after separate validation

tracks.name: three-projection tanh activation conversion
tracks.equation: z = up(x) * gamma * tanh(alpha * gate(x)); output = down(z)
tracks.scaling: per-layer alpha/gamma constrained to deployable ranges
tracks.later_combination: W8 plus short-stream only after isolated activation passes

reporting_boundaries: T, activation N and Ising S are separate
S is not ESS or hardware cycles
variable selector mean count is not a hard limit
no PPA improvement inferred from H100 simulation time
no additional research directions beyond the four requested tracks
